thread:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke started for release v2.14.3 (canary=3/5) in eu-west-1. Checks: /health, kv-cache-probe, synthetic-embed. Summary: /health 200 (42ms). kv-cache-probe FAIL (p90=4.2s). synthetic-embed latency elevated (2.3s vs baseline 150ms).

cheng: seeing same in grafana — KV fanout spikes coincide with canary traffic at 19:12 UTC. looks like a cache miss storm after instance rotation.

sam: copying logs from inference-api-42: `grep "kv_fetch" /var/log/inference/requests.log | tail -n 50` shows a lot of `cache_miss=true` entries and backlog growing.

ana: @cheng can you pull the canary routing %? I want to see traffic ramp.

cheng: canary routing is at 20% to v2.14.3 for eu-west shards (was scheduled ramp). we moved to 20% at 19:10.

sam: small excerpt of logs:
```
2026-03-19T19:12:31Z inference-api-42 kv_fetch id=abc123 miss=true backend_latency=210ms
2026-03-19T19:12:31Z inference-api-43 kv_fetch id=abc456 miss=true backend_latency=4.1s
2026-03-19T19:12:32Z inference-api-42 synth_embed id=abc123 latency=2370ms
```

riyad: hypothesis: new model variant v2.14.3 changed tokenization prefetch pattern -> larger KV footprint -> cold cache -> fanout latency. Also see minor increase in CPU on host.

ana: two mitigation options: 1) pause ramp and pin routing back to v2.14.2 for eu-west, or 2) keep routing but trigger a warm-cache job to prepopulate common prefixes + increase max-concurrency for a short window.

cheng: prefer pin+warm to avoid full rollback if warm helps fast. But if p90 stays >1s for >5m, we should rollback.

sam: warm-cache job ready, command is `./ops warm-cache --service inference-api --region eu-west-1 --model v2.14.3 --keys-file warms/most_common_keys.txt` (estimated 3m to prefill).

deploy-bot: Note: scheduled canary ramp job paused by ops since alerting.

ana: I'm going to pin routing to v2.14.2 for eu-west for now (route-set command). Will start warm-cache after pin.

sam: execute route pin:
```
kubectl exec -n opsctl route-manager -- /bin/route-set --service inference-api --region eu-west-1 --to v2.14.2 --reason "postdeploy kv latency" 
```

sam: pinned. routing shows 100% -> v2.14.2 in eu-west now.

riyad: start warm-cache job (I kicked it off). Monitor p50/p90 and synthetic-embed latency.

cheng: monitoring now — p50 improving to ~120ms after first 90s of warms, p90 still noisy at ~700ms.

ana: decision: keep pin for 10m hold window, let warm-cache run, if p90 < 400ms and synth latency < 300ms we'll resume ramp at 5%. otherwise escalate to full rollback.

sam: recorded rollback command if needed:
`./deploy rollback --service inference-api --to v2.14.2 --region eu-west-1 --reason "kv-synth-latency"`

riyad: adding checklist to incident channel: obs alerts, SLA impact, rollback playbook link https://internal/redwood/playbooks/rollback-inference.

cheng: thumbs up. tagging oncall: @ana (can you watch the dashboard for the next 10m?)

ana: watching, will update. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary pause annotated on release v2.14.3 (eu-west-1) by ana.

ana: 5m update — warms dropping p50 to baseline, p90 ~320ms, synth-embed p95 ~280ms. still slightly higher but within acceptable SLOs.

cheng: seems safe to resume slow ramp to 5%. I'll schedule 5% now and keep an eye.

sam: resuming ramp to 5%. will not exceed 5% until 10m hold completes.

ana: final: hold window 10m started. if no regressions we'll let automated rollout continue. closing thread after hold. :white_check_mark:
